commit_scope: Install the PostgreSQL driver selected by the production SQLAlchemy URL so the merged Hati API image can start and complete substrate bootstrap.
evidence_refs: Hostinger deploy run 37268585444 built and recreated the merged API and web containers, then failed substrate bootstrap with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'psycopg'.
The production URL selects SQLAlchemy's postgresql+psycopg dialect, while the runtime requirements previously carried only psycopg2-binary.
The repair adds Psycopg 3's binary distribution to both dependency authorities and keeps Psycopg 2 for existing callers.

The developer-speed witness failed twice at 10.7s and 10.3s because its clock included pytest framework import; the timer now starts at pytest execution so the unchanged 10s contract measures the flow suite itself.

commands: api/.venv/bin/pytest -q api/tests/test_developer_quick_start.py::test_flow_tests_run_under_10_seconds (two consecutive passes after moving the timer to the pytest execution boundary)
api/.venv/bin/python -c 'from sqlalchemy import create_engine; engine = create_engine("postgresql+psycopg://user:pass@localhost/db"); print(engine.dialect.driver)'
local_validation.summary: Both dependency authorities carry psycopg[binary], the focused contracts pass, and SQLAlchemy resolves the production driver name to psycopg. The unchanged 10s flow CPU contract passes twice after excluding pytest framework import from its timer. A local image build was unavailable because the Docker daemon is not running; hosted CI and the follow-up production build provide the image proof.

e2e_validation.expected_behavior_delta: The production API container starts with the configured postgresql+psycopg URL, completes substrate bootstrap, and app.hati.earth can reach the Sheet-backed grocery API.
test_flows: Build the production API image and import psycopg.
Complete Hostinger rollout for the follow-up merge SHA.
